Title: Senior Technical Delivery Manager - Web & Cloud Platforms
Industry: Broadcast Media Production and Distribution, Book and Periodical Publishing, and Telecommunications
Description:
Our Technology team wakes up every day with one goal in mind - connecting Canadians to the people and things that matter most. Together, we are proud to support 30 million Canadians each month through managing a robust portfolio that champions leading-edge technology. We drive large-scale, complex, and high-visibility technology projects and programs that shape the future of technology in Canada and expand connectivity from coast to coast. If you are interested in being a part of this, consider applying for the following opportunity
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**
As Senior Technical Delivery Manager, you will build and lead high-performance engineering teams that deliver and run our Web, Services, Middleware and Cloud Native platforms. You will own the full lifecycle, from strategy and architecture through delivery and day-to-day operations, using modern technologies such as React, Angular, Node.js, Java/Spring Boot and .NET, deployed on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud with Kubernetes and serverless services.
  
  
This is a leadership role with two equal mandates drive innovation at the core of how we build, and achieve operational excellence in how we run. You will set engineering direction, grow managers and senior engineers, and deliver industry-standard, secure and scalable solutions that let our customers self-serve. You will partner with senior leadership to align technology investment with business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build, lead and grow high-performance delivery teams, including managers and technical leads.
* Own the strategy and roadmap for Web, Services, Middleware and Cloud Native platforms.
* Drive innovation by evaluating emerging technologies and scaling proven ideas into production. Deliver large programs end to end, on time, on budget and against clear KPIs.
* Oversee architecture, integration and code quality to industry standards, including APIs, microservices and GraphQL.
* Lead cloud-native build and migration, with strong DevOps, automation and cost control.
* Embed secure authentication and SSO across applications, working with security and identity teams.
* Own operational excellence availability, SLOs, incident management, monitoring and root cause analysis.
* Partner with Product, Design, Data, Security and Operations, and present strategy and trade-offs to senior leadership.

**What You Need To Succeed**

* Cloud experience (required) hands-on depth with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP), including PaaS, containers and Kubernetes, serverless and cloud-native architecture patterns.
* Proven record of building and leading high-performance engineering teams, including managing managers, in an enterprise environment.
* Strong expertise across web application frameworks (React, Angular or Vue on the frontend; Node.js, Java/Spring Boot on the backend), backend services and APIs, microservices and middleware.
* Solid knowledge of integration and middleware technologies API gateways, messaging and event streaming, ESB and iPaaS.
* Deep understanding of industry standards for connecting domain services, microservices and experience-layer services such as GraphQL and REST.
* Mature DevOps and SRE practice CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, SLOs and incident management.
* Strong leadership in Agile delivery at scale, with a track record of shipping quickly without compromising quality or stability.
* Data-driven, KPI-focused approach, using tools such as 5-why analysis, A/B testing and performance benchmarking.
* Ability to balance innovation with operational stability, cost and risk.
* Excellent communication, with the ability to influence senior leaders and translate complex engineering topics into business value.
* Curiosity, creativity and a bias for action when tackling complex problems.

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of authentication and identity platforms, such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity, ForgeRock or Auth0.
* Experience implementing SSO and identity federation using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SAML.
* Familiarity with customer identity (CIAM), MFA and zero-trust security models.
* Relevant certifications, such as a cloud architect certification, Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD) or SAFe.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering and technical delivery, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and 3+ years managing managers or multiple squads.
* Proven delivery of web, services, middleware and cloud-native solutions at enterprise scale.
* A track record of running production platforms with measurable gains in reliability, performance and cost.
* A passion for digital transformation and a demonstrated ability to deliver innovative solutions that improve customer experience.

**What’s in it for you?**
We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including
  
  

* Competitive salary & annual bonus.

* Discounts Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers Services and Blue Jays Tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.

* Growth & Development Opportunities

Title: Senior Telemetry Service Operations Manager
Description:
**Overview**
As a Microsoft
**Senior Telemetry Service Operations Manager**
, you will own the availability, quality, and trustworthiness of critical environment (CE) telemetry across Microsoft’s global data center fleet. You will set operational standards and drive external providers and internal engineering teams to resolve complex issues, improve service performance, and reduce systemic risk.
  
  
Telemetry Service Operations (TSO) monitors telemetry availability and quality across Microsoft’s data center portfolio. The team takes a proactive approach by identifying availability, quality, and operational issues before they affect the teams that depend on the data. We validate issues before escalation, so partners receive actionable information.
  
  
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As part of CO+I, you will play a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft’s online services, including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. CO+I supports the personal and professional development of employees through training, growth opportunities, career rotation programs, inclusion programs, and professional certifications.
  
  
Our infrastructure comprises a global portfolio of more than 300 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. It is built and managed by subject matter experts who support services used by more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries.
  
  
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve to meet changing business demands.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to achieve our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own telemetry health for a region or external-provider portfolio; independently detect and validate complex incidents; determine severity, scope, and business impact in ambiguous situations; and identify fleet-level or systemic risks.
* Own complex and long-running incidents through their full lifecycle, set the standard for investigation and record quality, manage provider escalation paths, and drive accountability for remediation and service-level performance.
* Lead post-incident review and problem management for major, recurring, or high-impact issues; confirm root causes, assess wider fleet exposure, and drive corrective actions to closure across organizational boundaries.
* Set direction for closing telemetry-coverage and detection gaps, translate operational risk into prioritized engineering requirements, and lead automation and alert-tuning initiatives that improve detection coverage and reduce manual effort.
* Own service-acceptance standards, operating procedures, playbooks, and knowledge content for an assigned area, and resolve cross-team issues when telemetry does not meet readiness criteria.
* Define service measures and reporting, represent telemetry performance and external-provider accountability in operational reviews, and communicate risks and remediation status to leadership and partner organizations.
* Lead cross-team service-quality initiatives and mentor service managers and vendor staff, acting as an escalation point for difficult incidents, investigations, and external-provider engagements.
* Participate in a shared on-call rotation supporting 24x7x365 telemetry operations, including scheduled coverage outside standard business hours, weekends, and holidays, and serve as the senior escalation point for major incidents during those periods.
* Set a continuous feedback loop with downstream customers and act as the coordinator between users of the data and telemetry technical implementation groups.
* Embody our culture and values.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field AND 4+ years of technical experience in service operations, service engineering, systems engineering, critical environment operations, industrial control systems, or incident management

+ OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements**
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  
  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications**
While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Domain background in data center critical environments, electrical, industrial, or mechanical systems, gained through formal study or hands-on field experience.
* 5+ years of experience in an operational, mission-critical, 24x7x365 environment.
* 3+ years of experience leading incident, problem, or service-management work, including formal root-cause analysis, post-incident review, and corrective-action ownership; ITIL or equivalent service-management experience.
* Deep working knowledge of data center critical environment equipment, industrial control systems, and telemetry data flows, including generators, uninterruptible power supplies, power distribution units, switchgear, Modbus, or BACnet.
* Experience analyzing large operational datasets and defining service measures or dashboards using tools such as Kusto, SQL, Power BI, or Grafana.
* Experience holding third-party providers accountable through escalations and performance reviews and driving corrective action across teams without direct authority.
* Experience defining operational standards, playbooks, or service processes and mentoring less-experienced engineers or service managers.
* Deep working knowledge of data center critical environment equipment, industrial control systems, and telemetry data flows, including generators, uninterruptible power supplies, power distribution units, switchgear, Modbus, or BACnet.
* Experience using Kusto Query Language (KQL) or similar tools to query and analyze large-scale telemetry or operational data.

Description:

Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Chez Bell, nous bâtissons un avenir plus connecté grâce à des réseaux de calibre mondial, à des solutions propulsées par l’IA et à des expériences numériques qui améliorent la façon dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se divertissent chaque jour.
  
  
Nous croyons à l’autonomisation de chacun. C’est pourquoi nous dotons nos équipes d’une technologie de pointe, d’outils d’IA et d’un environnement collaboratif qui soutient la créativité et la croissance. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Si vous êtes inspiré par l’innovation qui fait progresser la façon dont les gens se connectent et transforme ce qui est possible, vous avez votre place au sein de l’#ÉquipeBell.
  
  
Faites partie de notre équipe Expérience client, où vous aurez un rôle déterminant dans l’élaboration des expériences client. Vous vous appuierez sur l’impératif stratégique de Bell qui s’intitule « Promouvoir l’expérience client » et renforcerez notre engagement à donner la priorité au client dans tout ce que nous faisons. Vous concevrez des processus, des politiques, des produits et des services novateurs axés sur le client, tout en respectant nos engagements envers le client afin qu'il soit plus facile pour eux de faire affaire avec Bell.
  
  
En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous serez au cœur de l’expérience client.
  
  
**Résumé**
Chaque projet d'envergure au sein du Réseau d’IA tissé de Bell soulève des centaines de questions :
  
  
L'alimentation électrique est-elle suffisante? La connectivité peut-elle être livrée? Quels sont les enjeux réglementaires, environnementaux, commerciaux, communautaires, opérationnels ou techniques? Quels risques demeurent inconnus? Bell devrait-elle aller de l'avant, adapter son approche, suspendre ou abandonner l'occasion?
  
  
Ce poste existe pour répondre à ces questions. Vous recueillerez et validerez les faits, structurerez les analyses, coordonnerez les activités de diligence interfonctionnelles, intégrerez les résultats et présenterez des recommandations claires. Vous deviendrez une référence de confiance quant aux faits, aux risques, aux dépendances, aux décisions et aux prochaines étapes des dossiers qui vous seront confiés.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**
Diriger les activités d'évaluation et de diligence raisonnable
  
  

* Diriger les évaluations et analyses de diligence pour les opportunités assignées, de l'évaluation préliminaire jusqu'à la recommandation finale et à la préparation de l'exécution.
* Coordonner les analyses techniques, commerciales, financières, opérationnelles, réglementaires, environnementales et communautaires.
* Structurer des enjeux complexes en hypothèses, analyses, plans de travail et cadres décisionnels clairs.
* Cerner les lacunes d'information, les questions non résolues et les hypothèses critiques, puis établir les plans nécessaires pour obtenir et valider les données requises.

Soutenir la prise de décision des dirigeants
  
  

* Transformer de grands volumes d'information en recommandations claires et exploitables pour les dirigeants.
* Présenter de façon concise les options, les compromis, les risques, les dépendances et les recommandations.
* Soutenir les discussions avec les dirigeants, les clients, les partenaires, les gouvernements et d'autres intervenants clés grâce à des analyses fondées sur les faits.
* Veiller à ce que les décisions soient prises à partir d'une information exacte, complète et fiable.

Agir comme référence pour les dossiers sous votre responsabilité
  
  

* Maintenir une vue consolidée et à jour des faits, hypothèses, risques, décisions et dépendances.
* Assurer la traçabilité des décisions et de leur justification.
* Produire et maintenir une documentation claire et structurée.
* Fournir une visibilité continue sur l'avancement des dossiers et les décisions à venir.

Assurer la coordination interfonctionnelle et la préparation à l'exécution
  
  

* Traduire les opportunités en plans de réalisation intégrés comportant des responsabilités, échéanciers, livrables et jalons clairement définis.
* Coordonner les activités entre les équipes internes, les consultants, les fournisseurs de services publics, les partenaires d'ingénierie et les parties externes.
* Gérer les mandats confiés à des experts et conseillers externes.
* Assurer le suivi des engagements, des dépendances et des échéanciers.
* Faire remonter rapidement les enjeux, risques ou décisions nécessitant l'attention de la direction.

Renforcer la gouvernance et les façons de faire
  
  

* Développer et améliorer un modèle de gouvernance par étapes permettant d'évaluer les opportunités selon des critères cohérents.
* Contribuer à la priorisation des initiatives et à l'allocation des ressources.
* Mettre en place des cadres, méthodologies et outils réutilisables afin d'augmenter l'efficacité du Réseau d’IA tissé de Bell à mesure de sa croissance.

Réaliser des analyses stratégiques
  
  

* Mener des recherches, analyses comparatives, entrevues avec des intervenants et analyses de données.
* Remettre en question les hypothèses et distinguer les faits des estimations.
* Détecter les enjeux émergents susceptibles d'influencer les décisions stratégiques.
* Mettre à profit les outils d'IA et d'analyse pour accélérer le travail tout en maintenant un haut niveau de rigueur et d'esprit critique.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* De 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en consultation en gestion, stratégie, gestion de programmes, développement d'infrastructures, opérations ou dans un environnement offrant une expérience comparable.
* Forte capacité à évoluer dans des contextes caractérisés par l'ambiguïté et l'information incomplète.
* Excellente capacité à structurer des problèmes complexes et à les transformer en recommandations concrètes.
* Aptitude exceptionnelle à synthétiser l'information et à communiquer clairement avec les dirigeants.
* Solide expérience en gestion de projets et de programmes.
* Excellentes capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de jugement.
* Grande rigueur et souci du détail.
* Excellentes habiletés de communication écrite et verbale, incluant la préparation de présentations exécutives.
* Capacité démontrée à influencer et mobiliser divers intervenants sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
* Aptitude à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément dans un environnement en évolution rapide.

**Qualifications Souhaitées**

* Expérience dans les infrastructures numériques, les centres de données, les télécommunications, l'énergie, les services publics, l'ingénierie ou le développement immobilier.
* Expérience en soutien à la prise de décision exécutive.
* Expérience dans la coordination de processus complexes de diligence raisonnable.
* Connaissance du développement de sites, des infrastructures énergétiques ou de télécommunications, des permis ou des évaluations environnementales.
* Expérience dans la conception de cadres de gouvernance, de modèles de priorisation ou de processus décisionnels.
* Expérience dans la gestion de consultants et d'experts-conseils.
* Approche pragmatique, collaborative et orientée vers les résultats.
* Volonté d'évoluer vers des responsabilités de leadership plus larges.

Title: Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician Manager
Description:
**Overview**

As a Microsoft Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician Manager (DIAM), you will lead a team of Inventory & Asset Management technicians responsible for inbound/outbound logistics tasks, inventory cycle audits, and Data Center regulatory compliance activities. You will guide your employees to effectively run warranty processes and data bearing device (DBD) destruction. This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, drive focus on accurately and efficiently completing Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) tasks, and work with stakeholders to manage escalations as they arise.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Responsible for overall day-to-day operations and ensure inbound and outbound processes are running smoothly and effectively.
* Assess resource and workflow patterns to determine any needed changes in work assignments to ensure timelines are met.
* Support the planning, management, and communication of end-to-end project plans with applicable stakeholders and teams.
* Ensure that all issues are documented, tracked, discussed, and resolved with internal and external stakeholders as well as suppliers with consistent and complete communication.
* Coordinate and oversee relationships with any third-party vendors who perform DBD destruction as necessary ensuring all DBDs leaving premises do not contain customer information and are destroyed.

* Comply with established methodologies and approaches to ensure delivery and execution of contracts and purchase orders.
* Process price and procurement requests requested by Microsoft management in support of server, network, Storage Area Network (SAN), and spare requirements.

Title: Data Center Technicians Manager
Description:
**Overview**

As a Microsoft **Data Center Technician (DCT) Manager**, you will lead a team of technicians, providing expert guidance on performing hardware deployments, diagnostics on equipment, and hardware decommissions. You will support technician performance, prioritizing technician tasks while monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, provide training to technicians, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays.

Microsoft is unable to sponsor a work visa for this role due to the nature of the role's job duties.

 **Responsibilities**  

### **Datacenter Operations**

Encourages the sharing of expertise in and provides guidance on standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and decommissioning IT datacenter technology(ies) and equipment. Encourages the sharing of expertise and provides guidance on the functions of, and interactions between cabling infrastructure, network, server, and storage equipment. Develops awareness of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation components: Incident Management and Change Management.

Provides guidance on, and holds a team of technicians accountable for compliance with Data Center business unit policies, procedures, and deadlines. Proactively reviews and provides feedback regarding Data Center business unit policies, procedures, and deadlines. Resolves issues related to compliance or operational assurance activities directly, or with assistance from compliance colleagues and/or business partners. Provides input on improvement plan components for service delivery gaps or challenges.

Ensures a team of technicians can complete assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) per task type. Supports escalation of challenging or complex tickets to internal business partners and appropriately summarizes relevant issues for communication to direct-line management. Coordinates and assigns tasks to technicians, and/or provides input or coordination with appropriate program managers and direct-line management for ticket assignment automation to provide direction as needed, to ensure work is appropriately allocated to meet Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) per task type. Monitors progress of tickets assigned to teams of technicians and adjusts where necessary, to meet established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) per task type. Analyzes data related to technicians' performance on tickets and shares with direct-line management.

Advises on and reviews suggested modifications to process and procedures to manage changes and drive improvement in service quality and/or efficiency. Proactively investigates, evaluates, and analyzes changes. Reviews Process Change Notifications (PCNs) to evaluate impact on service execution and shares relevant information about change with stakeholders across functions and disciplines to mitigate the impact they may have on others. Encourages technicians to ask questions when they do not have required information, resolves others' questions in a timely manner, and may provide feedback on changes to processes to direct-line management, standards management teams, and/or project, program, or special initiative managers.

### **Datacenter Work Environment**

Traveling up to 25% typically domestically to and from multiple locations during the workday, and occasionally domestically to other sites for overnight stays. May work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours such as evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.

Occasional climbing of ladders. Frequent climbing of stairs and/or ramps. Prolonged standing. Occasional lifting up to 25lbs / 11kg without assistance. Occasional lifting 25-50lbs / 11-22.5kg with lift assistance. Occasional push or pull 50-75 lbs / 22.5-34kg with assistive device. Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction), defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria. Normal color vision for electrical work, defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria.

Promotes a positive and effective team environment by modeling best practices, leading regular team meetings, cross-discipline collaborations, and monitoring the status of work across their team to understanding the impact on other shifts/technician teams, engineering groups or internal business partner needs and the overall business. Provides, responds to, and encourages providing feedback regarding on ways to work more effectively or enhance efficiency within their team and adopts best practices shared within-and-across shifts or technician teams.

Working for extended periods under elevated levels of ambient noise, heat, and light due to necessary equipment and ventilation systems.

Conducts daily safety briefings, ensuring their team members attend, and/or participates in onsite safety committees. Completes required Environmental & Health Safety (EHS) training, ensures technicians comply with EHS training completion requirements and are compliant with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use), Task Hazard Analysis (THAs) completion, and use of appropriate equipment and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for assigned tasks. Adheres to and promotes a culture of safety, empowering technician teams to report and/or take proactive action regarding safety concerns, near-misses, and/or incidents. Participates in regular cadence proactive safety observation reporting processes and systems, and follows up with their team members as needed regarding actionable safety observations reported.

Completes required security and data management training, ensures technicians completion of applicable training, and maintains accountability for technician compliance with security and data management procedures/policies. Ensures that policies and procedures securing physical access to the data center or network site environment(s) are appropriately enforced. May escort third party vendors or IT support on-premises at data centers or network sites. Appropriately takes action and reports physical security access concerns and/or incidents, and gathers information about such events reported by their team to inform direct-line management and escalates to relevant stakeholders. Participates in identifying the root cause of any physical security access violations and manages corrective actions and escalations related to technician violations of physical security procedures or policies.

### **Managing Service**

Exercises judgment and discretion to contribute to issue tracking related to follow-up and resolution to overall quality of service escalations and/or proactive initiatives. Maintains responsibility for client and technician team interactions for escalations and/or engagements between them and other internal business partners.

Partners with internal and external stakeholders to manage the removal of risks to personnel and/or resource availability, performance, and compliance.

Identifies and assigns required training as applicable across all technician job focus areas and workloads (i.e., Break fix, Deployment, Simple Change, Decommission, IT Critical Environment) along with Personnel Management training in a timely manner per direct-line management assignment(s) and validates completion of assigned training by team members. May complete additional or supplemental training to obtain or maintain relevant industry or technical certifications and advise their team on relevant certifications to obtain.

Collects and reviews appropriate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for their team to support line of business (e.g. performance measures, long-term trends) and/or business intelligence analysis (e.g., service availability data, system health). Shares feedback from reviews with technicians to drive improvement in meeting KPI expectations and sharing learnings from reviews with direct-line management.

### **People Management**

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring. Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles. Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn. Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

### **Service Delivery**

Follows procedures to immediately engage Designated Responsible Individuals (DRIs) for appropriate communication, reporting, and incident management of data center technical or safety related incidents with direct-line management, internal business partners, and impacted engineering group contacts. Participates in bridge calls to provide details on incident status and executes on-site follow-up actions as directed if necessary. May leverage learnings to contribute to the improvement of quality of service and support.

Coordinates training packages for technicians on procedures for installation, deployment, upgrade, refresh, simple change, decommission and/or replacement of infrastructure cabling, network, storage, or server equipment. Provides guidance to technicians for developing an effective execution order of assigned tasks and ensures technicians have access to tools and/or supplies required to perform work. Investigates root causes of issues that may have negatively impacted ticket Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) per task type, and takes proactive corrective action.

Verifies compliance with standards and procedure for data-bearing devices (DBDs) destruction and/or confirms any-and-all such devices (e.g. hard-drives, solid-state drives, flash cards, etc.) contained within network, storage, or server equipment has been identified for eradication or destruction. Creates schedules for shift-based technicians to ensure positioning and availability to execute work as defined by organizational standards, negotiates with internal team colleagues to organize project timelines, with guidance from direct-line management, and appropriate notification to stakeholders.

Manages assigned projects or programs to meet service delivery objectives. Participates in pilot programs or task forces to ensure smooth implementation for future service delivery as directed.

Proactively reviews schedules and avoids conflicts when possible. Identifies, coordinates, manages expectations, and offers alternatives when defining technical solutions in light of ongoing operations and procedures (e.g., schedule, technical feasibility, policy, procedure, tools).

Evaluates procedures for performing quality checks to ensure they align with compliance standards and process adherence, and takes responsibility for impact to Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) by task type of work performed by technicians. Performs post-execution verification of grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling as needed to ensure alignment with all safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Templates (NDTs), taking corrective action(s) to address any non-compliance, and validates post-execution quality or validation training has been completed by applicable technicians to enable them. Identifies errors in deployment standards or Network Design Templates (NDTs) and coordinates directly with internal business partners, technologists, or subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop corrections as needed.

Evaluates diagnostic and troubleshooting processes and suggests improvements. Maintains advanced awareness of conditions, circumstances, and scenarios which may reflect significant customer or business impact within the Data Center environment, and escalates observations of imminent incident risks or potential situations immediately to direct-line management.

**Other**

Embody our culture and values.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma, GED, or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND 3+ years’ experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or related experience working with technical teams.
* 1+ year(s) experience directing, supervising, or managing others.
* Ability to work 12 hours shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends, and/or holidays.

**Background Check Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
* This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

***Preferred Qualifications:***

* Associate degree in Computer Science or related field and/or equivalent work experience.
* 4+ years’ experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
* 3+ years’ experience working in a production, mission-critical 24x7x365 data center environment.
* Applicable certifications: Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation, ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC), Certified Data Center Professional (CDCP), Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), Six Sigma Green Belt).

Title: Network Development Manager, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Networking
Description:
**Description**
Application deadline: Nov 15, 2026
  
  
Amazon's network is a key differentiator for AWS, enabling the global operation of thousands of applications across hundreds of thousands of servers worldwide. Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) extends that platform to the U.S. Government's most sensitive workloads, delivering AWS inside air-gapped, classified regions where the bar for reliability, security, and operational rigor is at its highest.
  
  
We are looking for a Network Development Manager to hire, manage, and develop a team of Network Development Engineers responsible for the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network. You will own capacity management and forecast planning, implementation, automation, change control, process management, and continuous improvement across the classified partitions. You will represent networking to service teams, infrastructure partners, and government stakeholders, ensuring we meet their needs for innovation, delivery, and safe operations in an environment where the margin for error is small and much of the tooling and telemetry commercial teams rely on has to be built.
  
  
At Amazon, we ask our technical leaders to be strong engineers who dive deep and help their engineers make sound decisions and deliver quality solutions. You will maintain a solid technical understanding of routing, switching, optical transport, and network automation, and ensure the right expertise exists on the team. You will also be a thoughtful people manager who mentors your engineers and builds an environment of mutual trust and respect, which matters even more in ADC where teams are smaller, more isolated, and carry a heavier operational load per person. The ideal candidate has a track record of driving operations and continuous improvement for large-scale, mission-critical networks, a passion for operational excellence, and the judgment to safely implement change, measure performance, and respond to events so the network always operates as intended.
  
  
The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network across the classified partitions: availability, performance, change control, and continuous improvement.
* Hire, develop, and retain a team of Network Development Engineers; own onboarding, career growth, 1:1s, and mentoring.
* Run a sustainable on-call rotation that honors SLAs without burning out a small classified-region team.
* Ensure network changes are designed, reviewed, and executed safely at scale under ADC's access and change-control constraints.
* Drive incidents and availability risks to resolution, and own Correction of Error (COE) follow-through so problems do not recur.
* Manage operations with data, metrics, and dashboards; build the monitoring, automation, and tooling ADC has historically lacked.
* Define and deliver team goals, align resources, and report status and risk to leadership.
* Close parity gaps with commercial AWS and contribute an ADC lens to standard planning (OP1/OP2).
* Represent networking to service, infrastructure, and government stakeholders so dependencies and deliverables are met.

A day in the life
  
  
You lead a team of Network Development Engineers operating AWS's network inside classified regions. A typical day mixes 1:1s and career coaching with reviewing network changes, walking through an incident or COE with an engineer, and unblocking cross-team dependencies. You spend time on the metrics that show where the network and the team need attention, and on the tooling, automation, and monitoring ADC is still building. You balance day-to-day operations against longer-term parity and capacity goals, and you represent networking to service, infrastructure, and government partners. You also participate in a management on-call escalation rotation.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
* 4+ years of managing teams experience
* 5+ years of engineering experience
* 8+ years of technology role experience
* Experience with network operations either as a manager or individual contributor

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience contributing to the creation and implementation of high-quality, high-volume recruiting plans
* Experience contributing to the definition and implementation of automation opportunities within an operations environment
* Experience representing your team or technical area to senior management

Description:

Reporting to the CEO, the
**Vice President, Service Delivery**
owns the end-to-end delivery of all managed, professional, cloud, and internal IT services. This executive leads a multi-site, cross-border organization comprising two regional Client Experience (help desk) teams (US and Canada), a Professional Services team (onboarding/offboarding, project management, project implementation, and support escalations), a Cloud Operations team (private cloud hosting in Nuvollo datacenters), and internal IT systems support and administration. The VP is accountable for client satisfaction, service quality (SLA’s), operational efficiency, service margin, and the scalability of the delivery platform — ensuring service delivery keeps pace with rapid organic and acquisition-driven growth while maintaining a unified, high-standard client experience across both countries. The VP is also responsible for full management of the Nuvollo’s PSA, RMM, and all other internal systems and plays a significant role in assisting with response to the annual SOC 2 Type 2 Audit.

This is a hands-on executive role appropriate to a ~100-person and growing organization: the VP is expected to remain close to operations, coach and develop a team of four direct leaders (plus an individual-contributor internal IT systems administrator), and personally drive key initiatives such as acquisition integration, service delivery standardization, and delivery tooling and automation. The VP, Service Delivery is an active member of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), participating in setting the overall strategic direction of the business. They will also participate in company Board meetings monthly.

**Reporting Relationships and Organizational Context**

* **Reports to:**
  Chief Executive Officer.
* **Direct reports:**
  Toronto Regional Client Experience Manager; New Jersey Regional Client Experience Manager; Director of Professional Services; Cloud Operations Manager; Internal IT Systems Administrator.
* **Organization led:**
  Approximately 70 delivery professionals across Canada, the US, India, and Pakistan spanning help desk, professional services, cloud operations, and internal IT.
* **Peer relationships:**
  Finance/HR; Technology and Innovation (vendor/tech stack selection and solution design); Commercial (sales and marketing).
* **Locations:**
  New Jersey (primary US office), Toronto (primary Canadian office), with remote and hybrid team members across both countries, India & Pakistan.
* **Classification:**
  Full-time, executive (FLSA-exempt / Ontario-exempt); hybrid working arrangement with regular presence in the New Jersey and Toronto offices and periodic travel between sites, datacenters, and acquired-company locations. Note: Travel cross-border between US and Canada is expected to be no more than 1-2x per quarter.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

***Service Delivery Leadership and Operational Excellence***

* Own the full lifecycle of service delivery across all service lines and both countries. Partner with Tech & Innovation team to establish and enforce standardized, documented, and repeatable delivery processes, standard operating procedures, and a consistent service catalog across US and Canadian operations. Ensure services are delivered on time, on budget, and to contractual SLA and quality standards.

***Client Experience and Satisfaction***

* Champion a client-first, high sense of urgency culture across both regional help desk teams. Ensure consistent, high-quality, 24x7-responsive support for clients globally, with clear escalation paths from tier-1 through professional services. Own the client satisfaction program — surveys, complaint resolution, and churn-risk intervention — including partnering with VP Commercial for retention strategies for at-risk accounts, and growth strategies for strategic accounts.

***SLA and Service Level Management***

* Define, negotiate (with Commercial), monitor, and consistently meet/exceed client SLAs and internal operational targets. Maintain robust service level reporting, breach and failure root-cause analysis, and corrective action programs. Ensure contractual commitments are realistic, profitable, and operationally achievable across time zones and borders.

***Cloud Operations and Infrastructure Reliability***

* Directly accountable, through the Cloud Operations Manager, for the private cloud hosting business: datacenter operations, Windows server and ERP hosting platforms, proper licensing, capacity planning, high availability, disaster recovery, backup integrity, and infrastructure security posture. Ensure platform reliability, uptime, governance and cost efficiency that support both client commitments and healthy service margins.

***Professional Services and Onboarding Excellence***

* Through the Director of Professional Services, own client onboarding and offboarding, project management, and professional services for project implementation. Drive fast, high-quality, consistent and standardized low-risk onboarding that accelerates time-to-value and revenue recognition, and ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and with high client acceptance. Own the escalation framework from the help desk teams into professional services and engineering resources. Own Project Management Office (PMO) for all all internal and client facing projects.

***Acquisition Integration and Scalable Growth***

* Lead the service delivery dimension of tuck-in MSP acquisitions: due diligence on delivery operations, integration planning and execution, standardization of tooling, processes, and service catalogs, retention of key technical and service staff, and rapid migration of acquired clients onto Nuvollo platforms and SLAs — while protecting the client experience of both acquired and existing clients.
* Active participant in pre-acquisition diligence and post-acquisition integration efforts.

***Team Leadership, Development, and Cross-Border Management***

* Build, coach, and retain a high-performing, engaged, dispersed delivery organization across the US, Canada, India and Pakistan. Set clear goals and accountability for direct reports; develop succession plans and career paths; foster a unified culture across geographic and national boundaries; and manage performance, hiring, and staffing levels to meet demand. Ensure effective scheduling, coverage, and workload balancing across time zones.

* ***Financial and Capacity Management***

Own the service delivery staffing budget. Partner with Finance on revenue recognition, project accounting, and cost allocation; partner with Commercial on scoping, pricing, and serviceability of new deals; partner with Tech & Innovation team on identification and definition of new services and standardized implementation and delivery processes, vendor partners and tech stack tools.

***Process Improvement, Automation, and AI Enablement***

* Drive continuous improvement across all delivery functions using metrics, root-cause analysis, and client feedback. Champion automation, AI-assisted support tooling, and self-service capabilities to improve response times, reduce cost-to-serve, and scale delivery capacity ahead of growth. Partner with Technology and Innovation on tooling and platform selection and on embedding AI consulting and governance practices into delivery.

***Security, Compliance, and Risk Management***

* Ensure delivery operations meet client contractual, regulatory, and cybersecurity obligations across both jurisdictions (e.g., cyber insurance requirements, privacy laws such as PIPEDA and state privacy statutes, and frameworks such as SOC 2 where applicable). Own operational incident and major outage management, including client communications, post-incident reviews, and remediation. Partner with Tech and Innovation leadership to ensure the security of Nuvollo’s own environment and hosted client infrastructure.

Title: IT Manager Operations And Infrastructure
Description:
**Job Description**
About the Client
  
  
The client is a Dubai-based real estate and hospitality developer building technology-enabled, design-led communities. It brings AI, smart-living systems and longevity-focused design into its residential and hospitality developments. Its engineering and agentic Smart Home/IoT teams are building intelligent environments that shape how AI is deployed in the physical world. It is now building a strong IT and infrastructure foundation to support that growth.
  
  
**About The Role**
The client is seeking a hands-on, highly versatile IT Manager & Infrastructure Lead to own, manage and scale its complete hybrid IT, server and vendor ecosystem. You will bridge technical operations and vendor management, overseeing RFPs, Statements of Work (SOWs), software licensing and hardware procurement (including AI edge servers and lab gear), while directly maintaining cloud and local infrastructure.
  
  
You will manage the core IT foundation supporting the engineering and agentic Smart Home/IoT development teams. From AWS account provisioning and Linux server administration to Proxmox virtualisation, NAS backup management, on-premises lab hardware and live Smart Home installations (servers, hubs and switches running ZigBee, KNX, Matter over Thread and similar protocols), you will keep systems resilient, secure and performant.
  
  
Key Responsibilities Requirements
  
  

* Vendor Management, RFPs, SOWs & Licensing
* Lead the drafting, technical review and management of RFPs and SOWs from software, hardware and service vendors.
* Review and optimise software licences, SaaS subscriptions and developer tooling across the organisation.
* Manage procurement pipelines for high-performance compute hardware, GPU setups, edge platforms (NVIDIA Jetson, ESP32, Raspberry Pi) and lab equipment.
* Monitor vendor SLAs, negotiate contract terms, and track IT budget allocations and spending.
* Cloud Administration & Linux Engineering
* Manage and provision AWS resources (IAM, VPCs, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, Cost Explorer) following security and cost-optimisation best practices.
* Serve as the principal Linux Administrator (Ubuntu, Debian, RHEL) for all on-premises, edge and cloud server instances.
* Build, deploy and manage containerised applications and local development environments using Docker and container registries.
* Virtualisation, Storage, Backups & Local Hardware Lab
* Administer, maintain and expand local virtualisation clusters using Proxmox VE (or ESXi) for staging, CI/CD runners and test environments.
* Manage NAS/SAN storage architectures (e.g., TrueNAS, Synology) to ensure high-speed data availability, multi-tier automated backups and disaster recovery execution.
* Maintain local hardware lab infrastructure, including managed network switches, VLANs, routers, firewalls, power redundancy (UPS) and IoT hardware test benches.
* Smart Home Installations, Networking & Telemetry
* Install, manage and maintain Smart Home installations, including home servers, controllers, hubs, gateways, sensors and smart switches/actuators.
* Configure and support devices across Smart Home protocols such as ZigBee, KNX, Matter over Thread, Z-Wave and Wi-Fi/IP-based devices, including Thread border routers and KNX IP interfaces.
* Work with installation vendors and electrical contractors to plan, schedule and oversee hardware installations, reviewing their designs and SOWs and signing off on commissioning and handover.
* Design and manage the local network infrastructure supporting the Smart Home systems: VLAN segmentation for IoT devices, Wi-Fi coverage, PoE, firewall rules, and secure remote access via Tailscale (tailnets, ACLs, subnet routers and exit nodes).
* Configure and manage camera systems (IP/PoE cameras, NVRs, RTSP/ONVIF streams), including placement, recording and retention policies, and secure access.
* Deploy, calibrate and maintain sensors, including mmWave radar and presence/occupancy sensors, Bluetooth/BLE beacons and proxies, and motion, contact and environmental sensors.
* Build and assemble ad-hoc ESP32-based devices (soldering, wiring sensors and relays, power supply design and enclosure fitting), and flash and maintain their firmware (e.g., ESPHome, Arduino/ESP-IDF).
* Oversee monitoring and telemetry from installed systems (device health, uptime, alerting, logs and metrics, e.g., MQTT, Prometheus, Grafana), and drive troubleshooting, firmware updates and preventive maintenance.
* Experience: 5+ years in System Administration, DevOps or IT Infrastructure Management.
* Linux Expertise: Expert-level mastery of Linux system administration, performance tuning, security hardening and scripting (Bash, Python).
* Cloud & Virtualisation: Strong experience managing AWS cloud infrastructure and hypervisor environments such as Proxmox VE.
* Containers & Storage: Hands-on experience with Docker, container networking and enterprise storage systems (NAS, ZFS, RAID configurations).
* Vendor & Budgeting: Direct experience managing vendor relationships, evaluating RFPs/SOWs, tracking licences and executing hardware procurement.
* Networking & Hardware: Solid understanding of LAN/WAN, VPNs, VLANs and firewalls, and hands-on hardware troubleshooting.
* Smart Home Systems: Proven experience installing, managing and maintaining Smart Home installations (servers, hubs, switches and controllers) using protocols such as ZigBee, KNX and Matter over Thread.
* Tailscale & Remote Access: Working knowledge of Tailscale for managing virtual VPNs/mesh networks across sites, servers and devices.
* Cameras & Sensors: Experience configuring and managing IP camera systems, and deploying sensors such as mmWave radar, presence and Bluetooth/BLE devices.
* Electronics & Hardware Assembly: Good hands-on electrical knowledge (soldering, wiring, low-voltage power, reading schematics) for assembling ad-hoc ESP32-based devices.
* Installation Vendor Coordination: Experience working with installers and contractors to deliver on-site hardware installations, from design review through commissioning.
* Monitoring & Telemetry: Hands-on experience setting up monitoring, alerting and telemetry for networked devices and IoT/Smart Home systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Title: IT Manager (Operations & Infrastructure)

Title: Project Manager (Data Center Delivery & Liquid Cooling)
Description:
**About the role**

Astreya is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work, guided by Astreya's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, are why our people love working at Astreya.

We are hiring a **Director, Digital Infrastructure – Data Center Delivery & Liquid Cooling** to join our Power & Utilities (P&U) practice in **Dubai, UAE**. The region is building AI-ready, high-density data center capacity at pace, and liquid cooling is now on the critical path of most of those builds. You will be the senior Astreya lead on the ground for clients delivering these facilities, from investment case and design decisions through construction, commissioning and handover, with particular depth in direct-to-chip and immersion cooling systems and the heat-rejection plant that supports them.

* **Lead data center delivery on the ground.** Run the day-to-day delivery of major data center build workstreams or smaller engagements. Act as the senior client counterpart in Dubai and keep the program moving without waiting for direction.
* **Own the liquid cooling agenda.** Advise on cooling strategy for high-density and AI/HPC halls, including direct-to-chip (cold plate), rear-door heat exchangers, single- and two-phase immersion, and hybrid air/liquid designs. Translate rack-density and IT roadmaps into practical cooling architecture choices.
* **Bridge technical performance and economics.** Connect cooling design decisions (CDUs, secondary fluid networks, chillers, dry coolers, heat rejection, water use) to PUE, WUE, capex, opex, schedule and risk. Keep that link visible to investors, operators and executives.
* **Structure ambiguous problems.** Set the analytical path across site selection, design reviews, technology selection, capacity phasing, and power and water availability in a hot, arid climate. Lead the team to a clear answer.
* **Build the fact base.** Develop business cases, cost and schedule benchmarks, value bridges, cooling option appraisals and implementation plans that make the financial and operational implications clear.
* **Drive the build through to handover.** Stand up delivery governance, PMO or control-tower disciplines across design, procurement, construction, integrated systems testing and commissioning. Track long-lead cooling equipment, vendor and EPC performance, interfaces between MEP and IT fit-out, and value capture.
* **Manage contracts and claims.** Support EPC, design-and-build and OEM contracting strategy, performance guarantees, change control and claims positions, especially where cooling scope crosses multiple contractors.
* **Stay close to the client.** Lead working sessions and steering meetings with developers, hyperscale and colocation operators, utilities and investors. Handle difficult conversations well and produce concise materials that make the decision and next action clear.
* **Grow the practice.** Spot follow-on needs, shape proposals, develop points of view on liquid cooling and AI-ready infrastructure in the Middle East, and contribute to account plans and pursuits.
* **Integrate expertise.** Bring in Astreya specialists and external experts (thermal engineering, commissioning agents, energy and water) when needed so the client receives one integrated answer.
* **Own quality and economics.** Own project quality, scope, schedule, team performance and engagement economics. Coach Managers and junior team members and help build Astreya's digital infrastructure capability in the region.

**Education and experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Building Services (MEP) Engineering; master's degree or PMP a plus.
* 10+ years in mission-critical facilities, with at least 5 years on hyperscale, colocation or enterprise data center builds.
* Delivered at least one data center build or retrofit that deployed liquid cooling at scale, ideally for AI/GPU or HPC halls above 40 kW per rack.
* Recent project experience in the UAE or wider GCC, including work with local authorities, utilities and contractors.

**Data center build and delivery**

* Full build lifecycle: site selection, concept and detailed design reviews, procurement, construction, fit-out, commissioning and handover to operations.
* MEP coordination across power (MV/LV, UPS, generators), cooling, fire protection and BMS/EPMS, and the interface with IT and white-space fit-out.
* Commissioning Levels 1–5 and integrated systems testing (IST), including witness testing of cooling plant and failure scenarios.
* Program controls: master schedules, critical path, long-lead equipment tracking, cost and change control, RFIs and risk registers.
* Managing EPC, MEP and OEM contractors, including contract structures, performance guarantees, variations and claims.
* Health, safety and quality management on live construction sites.

**Liquid cooling (core technical skills)**

* Direct-to-chip (cold plate) systems: coolant distribution units (CDUs), technology cooling system (TCS) loops, manifolds, quick disconnects and rack integration.
* Immersion cooling, single- and two-phase: tank layouts, dielectric fluids, fluid handling and service procedures.
* Rear-door heat exchangers and hybrid air/liquid designs for mixed-density halls.
* Facility water systems (FWS) and heat rejection: chillers, dry coolers, adiabatic and evaporative systems, cooling towers, and free-cooling limits in high ambient temperatures (45°C+).
* Fluid quality and reliability: water treatment, filtration, leak detection, flushing and pressure testing, and redundancy design (N+1, 2N).
* Thermal and energy performance: supply/return temperatures, ASHRAE TC 9.9 liquid cooling classes (W17–W45), PUE and WUE modelling, and heat reuse options.
* Working knowledge of GPU platform cooling requirements (e.g. NVIDIA GB200/GB300 NVL72-class racks) and OEM specifications.
* Familiarity with leading liquid cooling vendors and their products (e.g. Vertiv, Schneider Electric/Motivair, CoolIT, nVent, Submer, GRC).

**Commercial and leadership**

* Building business cases and cooling option appraisals that link capex, opex, PUE/WUE, schedule and risk.
* Leading multidisciplinary teams of engineers, contractors and client staff through ambiguity and fast-moving priorities.
* Presenting technical trade-offs clearly to executives, investors and operators, and turning them into decisions.
* Client relationship management, proposal development and negotiation.

**Nice to have**

* Uptime Institute (ATD/ATS), CDCP/CDCS, BICSI or LEED certifications.
* Knowledge of Uptime Tier, TIA-942 and Open Compute Project (OCP) standards.
* Experience with Dubai Municipality, Civil Defence and DEWA approvals.
* Arabic language capability.

**Location and travel**

* Based in **Dubai, UAE**, working on client sites across the UAE.
* Willingness to travel across the GCC, wider Middle East and Africa as engagements require.

Title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
Location: Doha, Qatar | Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
  
  
We are hiring a
**Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer**
to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an “automation-first” senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical’s IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.
  
  
As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you’ll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical’s leading products for software operation automation.
  
  
In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they’re based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.
  
  
You’ll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical’s customers and the Ubuntu Community.
  
  
**As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will**

* Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
* Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
* Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
* Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
* Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
* Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical’s core services, networks, and infrastructure
* Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
* Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
* Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
* Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and ‘doing work together’
* Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations

What we are looking for in you
  
  

* A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
* A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
* Python software development experience, with large projects
* Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
* Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
* Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
* Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
* Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
* Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
* Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
* Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
* Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
* A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
* Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
* Happy to work within distributed teams
* Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

What we offer colleagues
  
  
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  
  

* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

**About Canonical**
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
  
  
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Title: Infrastructure Engineering Manager

Description:
**Job Description**
Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 400+ energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies.
  
  
We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big!
  
  
**Meet the team!**
Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team.
  
  
As an Infrastructure Engineering Manager at Unifonic, you will lead the engineering and operations of production cloud platforms, combining Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Platform Engineering, and AI-native engineering to ensure reliability, scalability, security, performance, and automation. You will remain hands-on by reviewing infrastructure code and architecture, troubleshooting complex production issues, working with Kubernetes and cloud services, and using AI engineering tools such as Claude Code daily. You will focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), with strong practical GCP expertise to support the ongoing migration to GCP, while collaborating with the Infrastructure Engineering Manager – Developer Experience, who is responsible for non-production environments, CI/CD, and developer tooling.
