Title: Network Operations & Engineering Manager
Description:
Job Title: Network Operations & Engineering Manager
  
  
Job Category: Information Technology
  
  
Time Type: Full time
  
  
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None
  
  
Employee Type: Regular
  
  
Percentage of Travel Required: None
  
  
Type of Travel: None
  
  
\* \* \*
  
  
**The Opportunity**
CACI is seeking a Network Operations & Engineering Manager to join our Desktop Support Services (DSS) team supporting the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). The Network Operations & Engineering Manager will serve as the technical manager and unified point of leadership for network engineering operations across multiple DHS DSS task orders. This role is responsible for providing management oversight of Tier 1 NOC, Tier 2 WAN/LAN, and Tier 3 WAN/LAN teams while ensuring standardization, consistency, and excellence in network support delivery across all contract task orders. The Network Engineering Lead will act as the single, authoritative voice representing all DSS network operations to DHS stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Serve as the technical manager and unified leader for network engineering operations across multiple DSS task orders. Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Provide technical leadership and management oversight for Tier 1 NOC, Tier 2 WAN/LAN, and Tier 3 WAN/LAN support teams across multiple task orders
* Act as the single, unified voice representing all contract network operations to DHS stakeholders and facilitate communication between technical teams, program management, and government stakeholders
* Lead, mentor, and develop network engineering staff through regular performance reviews, one-on-ones, and coaching to ensure high performance and professional growth
* Establish and enforce network engineering standards, best practices, and procedures to ensure consistency in network design, implementation, troubleshooting, and support methodologies across all DSS task orders
* Manage escalations between support tiers, provide technical expertise for complex network issues affecting desktop connectivity, and oversee handling of incoming escalations and participation in major incident bridge calls
* Manage, troubleshoot, and oversee maintenance of network devices including Cisco routers, switches, wireless access points, firewalls (ASA and Palo Alto), Bluecoat proxies, VPN, and Zscaler
* Evaluate and recommend changes and/or technology upgrades to address performance, standardization, and industry best practices
* Develop and maintain unified network documentation, runbooks, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), network architecture diagrams, Knowledge Base articles, work instructions, and job aids across all DSS contracts
* Establish metrics and KPIs to measure team performance, network health, and service delivery
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and service quality
* Lead postmortem activities and drive operational improvements based on lessons learned
* Ensure compliance with federal security requirements, DHS policies, and Government procedures
* Foster a unified team culture, ensure seamless collaboration and knowledge sharing across task order boundaries, and eliminate silos to deliver consistent service and user experience
* Lead technical review meetings, provide consolidated status updates to program management, and conduct knowledge transfer sessions with operations and engineering teams on new solutions, systems, applications, and tools
* Ensure teams respond effectively to systems alerts, triage, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents in 24/7/365 environment
* Manage coordination with other support teams including Service Desk and Security Operations Center
* Coordinate patching, updates, upgrades, refreshes, and other maintenance activities

**Qualifications**
*Required:*

* Ability to obtain DoD Top Secret/SCI Clearance
* Ability to obtain Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Entry On Duty (EOD)
* B.S. + 15 years of applicable experience OR M.S. + 12 years of applicable experience
* Minimum 5-7 years in a technical leadership or management role overseeing multi-tier network support operations (NOC, Tier 2, Tier 3) on a federal government contract
* Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) certification or higher
* ITIL Foundation certification (or ability to obtain within first three months)
* Expert-level knowledge of enterprise WAN and LAN technologies including Cisco switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, and wireless access points
* Advanced experience with Network analysis tools and IP services (IPv4/IPv6, Multicast, QoS, SDN, SNMP, VoIP, VTC)
* Strong experience with routing protocols and technologies (OSPF, BGP, MPLS, RSVP/LDP L2/3VPNs, VRFs, IKE/IPSec, GRE tunnels, MTU, Import/Export policies)
* Experience with network security technologies (firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, NAC) and wireless networking (802.11 standards, controllers, access points)
* Knowledge of network services critical to desktop support (DHCP, DNS, Active Directory integration)
* Experience using ServiceNow service management software (or similar tool)
* Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical issues for non-technical audiences
* Strong leadership and team-building capabilities with proven ability to influence and drive standardization across organizational boundaries
* Flexibility to work standard business hours with availability for critical incident response and occasional travel between customer sites

**Desired**

* Previous DHS experience supporting Desktop Support Services or similar enterprise IT contracts
* Previous DoD experience
* Active DoD Top Secret/SCI Clearance
* Active DHS Entry On Duty (EOD)
* CCIE (Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert) or equivalent expert-level certification
* Security+ or higher DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification
* Additional Cisco certifications (CCNA Wireless, CCNP Security, etc.)
* Wireless certifications (CWNA, CWSP, or vendor-specific)
* Deep knowledge of Problem Management best practices and processes
* Experience with Palo Alto firewalls, Bluecoat proxies, and Zscaler
* Familiarity with SD-WAN and modern network architectures

**What You Can Expect**
**A culture of integrity.**
At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
  
  
**An environment of trust.**
CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
  
  
**A focus on continuous growth.**
Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
  
  
**Pay Range**
There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

$120,800 - $265,800

Title: Manager, Network Operations
Description:
**Overview**
The Manager, Network Operations provides leadership and operational oversight for the Institute’s network and telecommunications services. The position manages assigned staff, establishes operational priorities, oversees service availability and performance, coordinates incident response and project delivery, and ensures that network and telecommunications services support organizational needs. The manager works with technical staff, Information Systems leadership, business stakeholders, and vendors to develop service strategies, manage technology lifecycles, address operational risk, and plan for growth. The position ensures appropriate staffing, technical coverage, documentation, escalation procedures, and continuity of operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide supervision and leadership for assigned staff, including recruitment, onboarding, coaching and development, performance management, goal setting, progressive discipline, work/leave scheduling, training, retention, and day-to-day workplace interventions and problem resolution. Establish clear performance expectations and build leadership and technical capacity within the team.
* Oversee the availability, performance, reliability, and ongoing support of network and telecommunications services. Establish operational priorities, assign resources, balance operational and project demands, monitor workloads, and ensure timely response and escalation of incidents and service requests.
* Ensure network and telecommunications platforms are securely maintained, documented, recoverable, and effectively managed throughout their lifecycle, including capacity planning, licensing, maintenance agreements, technology refresh planning, redundancy, continuity, and related operational requirements.
* Evaluate and prioritize technology improvements and lifecycle needs, including recommendations from technical staff and vendors related to software and code upgrades, resiliency, security, capacity, performance, and service stability. Provide recommendations on technology advancements that improve network performance and reliability.
* Plan and oversee special projects, determining appropriate use of staff, vendors, hardware, software, and other resources to accomplish objectives. Coordinate across Information Systems, business stakeholders, and vendors to establish responsibilities, facilitate communication, and support successful project completion.
* Partner with the Director, Network Operations to establish departmental goals, service priorities, staffing plans, performance measures, budgets, and multiyear technology roadmaps aligned with organizational priorities. Assist in developing and managing operating and capital budgets, including expenditures, forecasts, contracts, licenses, maintenance renewals, and procurement recommendations.
* Establish and monitor service levels and operational performance measures, including incident trends, recurring problems, capacity indicators, customer-impacting issues, and other relevant metrics. Develop improvement plans and provide statistical and management reporting on service performance, risks, and resource needs.
* Provide management oversight during significant service disruptions, coordinating technical resources, vendors, stakeholder communications, escalation, restoration priorities, and post-incident reviews. Ensure network and telecommunications changes follow established testing, approval, documentation, communication, and rollback procedures.
* Manage vendor and service-provider performance, establishing expectations, monitoring service delivery, addressing performance concerns, coordinating escalations, and ensuring contracted services meet organizational requirements.
* Partner with information security, infrastructure, compliance, and other stakeholders to identify and address operational, cybersecurity, continuity, and regulatory risks affecting network and telecommunications services.
* Ensure technical and operational documentation is complete, current, and accessible, including technical standards, support procedures, diagrams, inventories, escalation paths, and recovery procedures.

**Qualifications**
QUALIFICATIONS:
  
  
Cisco certification, relevant technical, management, project management, or service management certification preferred.
  
  
EDUCATION:
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences or related field required. Additional years of relevant experience above the minimum requirement may be substituted for the education requirement at the discretion of the Director, Network Operations.
  
  
EXPERIENCE:
  
  

* Seven years of progressively responsible experience supporting enterprise network, telecommunications, infrastructure, or related technology services required.
* Three years of experience supervising or leading technical staff, including responsibility for performance management, workload prioritization, project delivery, and operational support, required.
* Experience managing service availability, incident response, technology projects, vendors, budgets, and lifecycle planning preferred.
* Experience overseeing enterprise network and telecommunications environments, including wired and wireless networking, voice services, network security, and supporting platforms, preferred.
* Experience working in a complex, highly available, regulated, healthcare, education, or similarly service-sensitive environment preferred.
* Demonstrated experience translating technical risks and recommendations into operational and business terms for leadership and nontechnical stakeholders required.

USD $93,561.73/Yr.
  
  
**Maximum pay range**
USD $168,541.98/Yr.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
  
  
Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. * Experience operating in a fast-paced development environment with evolving requirements and aggressive delivery timelines.

**Description**
Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite broadband network to deliver fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world, including those underserved by traditional infrastructure. We are looking for an experienced Incident Manager to serve as a Technical Call Leader. When a high severity event affects more than one part of the network, detection, customer communication, and engineering recovery are all happening at once, and someone has to run the whole event. That someone is you. You will be the single accountable owner of a high severity event from the moment it is declared to the moment it is resolved and closed, coordinating engineers, operations, customer communications, legal, and security toward the fastest possible restoration of service for customers.
  
  
This is a coordination and leadership role, not a hands on resolver role. You will not perform the technical fix or make specialized safety decisions. You will make sure the right responders are engaged, the severity is assessed correctly, work that crosses team boundaries is sequenced, communication and any regulatory obligations are tracked, and the event ends in learning that prevents recurrence. Your effectiveness is measured by the quality of your coordination under pressure, not by personal troubleshooting. You are calm and diligent in high stress situations, you create urgency and focus, you ask the hard questions, and you can direct senior people who do not report to you.
  
  
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the single accountable call leader on high severity events, from declaration through resolution and closure.
* Assess and set event severity based on customer and business impact, and adjust it as the event evolves.
* Run the incident bridge, keeping the engineering effort and the customer communication effort aligned on a single source of truth.
* Sequence work across engineering, operations, mission and flight operations, customer communications, legal, and security, and engage the right responders quickly.
* Keep customer communication and any regulatory notification obligations visible and on time, at the same priority as the technical mitigation.
* Escalate early and freely, clear blockers, and make the stand down decision against clear recovery criteria
* Run clean handovers on prolonged events, and share a twenty four by seven on call rotation.
* Proactively investigate early warning signals to catch potential events before they reach customers.
* Own the post event loop, ensuring a correction of errors and root cause analysis are completed, assigned, and tracked to closure.
* Audit the coverage of monitoring and customer notification so events are detected and communications reach the right customers.
* Design, run, and score simulated incident exercises, and train partner teams on the incident process and their role on the call.
* Improve runbooks and incident tooling, reducing the manual work of running an event.

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Title: SOC Service Delivery Manager
Description:
**Summary**

  

The SOC Service Delivery Manager serves as the primary customer success leader for assigned Managed Security Services customers and is accountable for service performance, security governance, customer health, adoption, incident communications, and value realization. The role translates cybersecurity operations into meaningful business outcomes by building executive relationships, proactively managing customer health, and helping customers realize value from their partnership with Logicalis.

  
  
  

The role connects customers with Security Operations teams and aligns technical delivery with business priorities, security objectives, contractual commitments, and desired outcomes. The SOC Service Delivery Manager partners with SOC analysts, security engineers, solution architects, Account Executives, Customer Success leaders, and customer stakeholders to strengthen customer confidence, improve security outcomes, and support retention and long-term partnership success.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

*Customer Success, Relationship and Health Management*

  

* Serves as the primary operational relationship owner and trusted advisor for assigned Managed Security Services customers, builds relationships with executive sponsors and customer stakeholders, and maintains an understanding of each customer’s business objectives, security priorities, compliance requirements, risks, opportunities, and success measures.

  

* Aligns service delivery and continuous improvement to desired outcomes; monitors customer health, engagement, adoption, satisfaction, operational risk, and renewal risk; develops mitigation and service improvement plans for at-risk customers; and translates performance data into business insights and recommendations that support retention and renewal readiness.

  

*Security Service Delivery, Governance and Value*

  

* Owns the customer delivery experience for assigned Managed Security Services accounts and leads service reviews, business reviews, executive reviews, and security performance discussions to ensure alignment with contractual commitments, customer expectations, and desired outcomes.

  

* Reviews and communicates SLA performance, operational effectiveness, security trends, customer sentiment, performance measures, risks, and improvement opportunities in language appropriate for executive, business, and technical stakeholders, while driving accountability for commitments, remediation plans, operational deliverables, service quality, adoption, and customer value.

  

*Security Incident, Escalation and Problem Management*

  

* Serves as the primary customer communication lead during critical security incidents, significant service-impacting events, and escalations, and coordinates SOC analysts, security engineers, vendors, Account Executives, and other stakeholders through resolution with timely, accurate, and transparent communications.

  

* Translates technical findings, threat data, and business risk into executive-level communications and recommendations; leads escalations and post-incident reviews; analyzes incident and escalation trends; and tracks corrective actions to completion to reduce recurring customer friction.

  

*Onboarding, Adoption and Continuous Improvement*

  

* Leads the customer-facing transition of new Managed Security Services from implementation into steady-state operations by managing plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, readiness criteria, and stakeholder communications, and validates service configuration, monitoring, documentation, communication plans, escalation procedures, support processes, and stakeholder alignment.

  

* Ensures customers understand available services, responsibilities, support processes, reporting capabilities, governance structures, and escalation paths; identifies adoption barriers and operational gaps; and partners with Security Operations leadership to improve reporting, governance, operational efficiency, service quality, and customer experience.

  

*Cross-Functional Leadership and Commercial Management*

  

* Orchestrates technical, customer success, sales, professional services, vendor, and partner stakeholders around customer priorities; establishes ownership and accountability; and maintains customer documentation, governance records, service procedures, operational artifacts, and communications.

  

* Supports service expansions, integrations, technology changes, migrations, and operational improvements; maintains knowledge of customer contracts, service scope, entitlements, and commercial commitments; and partners with Account Executives and Customer Success teams on account strategy, renewals, adoption, service enhancements, and expanded security capabilities aligned to customer needs.

  

*General*

  

* Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis through performing behaviors consistent with the organization's values.

  

* Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as policies and procedures of Logicalis in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical and professional behaviors.

  

* Supports and conducts self in a manner consistent with customer service expectations.

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

  

This job has no direct supervisory responsibilities but requires leadership and influence across cross-functional teams.

  

**Qualifications**

  

To perform this job successfully, an individual should be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  
  

**Education/Experience/Technical Requirements/Certifications**

Equivalent combination accepted.

  
  

**Education:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information technology, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  

**Experience / Technical Requirements**

  

* 5+ years of experience in managed services, customer success, service delivery management, cybersecurity services, technical account management, consulting, or a related customer-facing technology role.

  

* Experience working within Managed Security Services, a Security Operations Center, an MSSP, or a cybersecurity-focused service organization is strongly valued.

  

* Experience owning strategic customer relationships, leading governance discussions, and aligning service delivery to customer business priorities and outcomes.

  

* Experience coordinating cross-functional technical teams and managing critical incidents, customer escalations, recurring service issues, and service improvement activities.

  

* Working knowledge of cybersecurity principles, SOC processes, incident response, security service delivery models, and service-level management.

  

* Broad familiarity with SIEM, EDR/XDR, MDR, vulnerability management, cloud and network security, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Cisco XDR, and Microsoft Defender technologies.

  

* Ability to interpret and communicate security operations measures such as acknowledgment, detection, response, notification, escalation, alert, and remediation performance without serving as the technical investigator.

  

* Experience presenting complex technical and operational information to executive, business, and technical audiences.

  

* Ability to apply practical, risk-based service management controls in a flexible, high-accountability model without relying on rigid or process-heavy frameworks.

  

* Proficient use of Microsoft Office applications.

  
  

**Certifications**

* ITIL Foundation or a comparable service management certification.

  

* Relevant security certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CISM, Microsoft SC-900, SC-200, or SC-100.

  

* Relevant project management, cloud, security, or service delivery credentials.

  
  

**Other Skills and Abilities**

* Demonstrated ability to build rapport, establish credibility, and earn trust with executive, business, security, and technical stakeholders.

  

* Strong customer-success orientation and commitment to improving customer outcomes, confidence, and experience.

  

* Ability to translate cybersecurity events, technical findings, operational performance, and risk into clear business discussions and recommendations.

  

* Ability to balance strategic relationship ownership with disciplined operational execution.

* Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.

  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, root cause analysis, and stakeholder management skills.

  

* Ability to maintain composure, exercise sound judgment, and lead communications during critical incidents and escalations.

  

* Ability to influence cross-functional teams, drive accountability without direct authority, prioritize competing demands, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  

**Physical Demands**

  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that should be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is constantly required to sit, talk, see, hear, and use hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand; move about, climb steps or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

  
  

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this classification. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of personnel so classified.

We value inclusion and belonging at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, marital status, age, height, weight, disability, veteran status, or any other reason prohibited by applicable federal or state laws.

Title: Manager, IT Network
Description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are seeking an IT Manager, Network Operations to lead the team responsible for the reliability, security and growth of our enterprise network. You will manage a team of network engineers, serve as the main escalation point for network reliability, infrastructure expansion and observability, and oversee the structured cabling and site deployment work that supports new and expanding locations. As Saronic scales, you will grow the function into dedicated network operations center (NOC), site deployment and integration teams, and drive our shift toward infrastructure as code and automation.
  
  
You are a hands-on leader who combines technical depth with people management and strategic planning. As Saronic grows, you will build the team, processes and standards that keep our network optimized and secure at scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop a team of network engineers ranging from associate to staff level, with full accountability for hiring, development, performance and retention.
* Set goals and expectations, run regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and make compensation and leveling recommendations.
* Build and scale the function into dedicated NOC, site deployment and integration teams, including staffing and coverage models.
* Own operational delivery and KPIs for network operations, including SLAs, uptime, change success rate and project delivery.
* Serve as the main escalation point for network incidents, reliability and infrastructure expansion, and build incident response processes with clear severity tiers, escalation paths, runbooks and post-incident reviews to reduce time to resolution.
* Own the monitoring, alerting and observability strategy, including tooling, tuning and dashboards.
* Drive adoption of infrastructure as code and automation using tools like Terraform and Ansible (or similar), including version-controlled configuration and standardized change workflows.
* Define network configuration and design standards, and coordinate change management so that changes are reviewed, approved and communicated.
* Drive the multi-quarter network roadmap, including capacity planning, lifecycle management and compliance initiatives (such as NIST 800-171, DFARS, CMMC and ITAR) where applicable.
* Plan and oversee network expansion for new and renovated sites, working with construction, facilities and contractors from design through commissioning.
* Establish structured cabling standards and develop deployment playbooks for staging, installing and validating network equipment at new sites and during technology refreshes.
* Lead network integration for acquired companies, including on-site assessments of acquired environments, sequenced integration plans, network cutovers and a reusable integration playbook.
* Manage the team budget, vendor relationships and procurement within delegated authority, including cabling contractors and telecom vendors.
* Partner with peer managers in IT, Security and Engineering, and with senior and staff engineers on technical strategy, network segmentation, access control and security policy.
* Maintain network documentation, including topology diagrams, IP schemas and operating procedures, and support audits as needed.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Network Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 7+ years of progressive enterprise networking experience, including experience leading engineers or technical teams.
* Experience with hiring, performance management and developing engineers at a range of experience levels.
* Demonstrated expertise in LAN and WAN design, routing and switching, wireless, and network security fundamentals.
* Experience overseeing network operations, including incident management and monitoring, alerting and observability platforms.
* Experience with network automation and infrastructure as code, or a demonstrated ability to drive their adoption within a team.
* Working knowledge of structured cabling and low-voltage infrastructure standards, including TIA-568 and TIA-569.
* Experience coordinating network deployments for new facilities with construction, facilities and contractor teams.
* Experience managing budgets, vendors and procurement.
* Strong project management skills across concurrent, geographically distributed projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Strong operational rigor and sound judgment when problem solving under pressure.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Industry certifications such as CCNP or equivalent, or BICSI credentials.
* Experience with IT service management platforms for ticket management and SLA reporting.
* Experience supporting network integration for acquired companies, carve-outs or multi-site consolidations.
* Background supporting global or multi-site enterprise environments.
* Experience supporting networks in hybrid or cloud environments, such as AWS/AWS GovCloud or Azure.
* Experience working in a defense, aerospace or other regulated environment, with familiarity with frameworks such as NIST 800-171 or CMMC.
* Willingness and eligibility to obtain a U.S. security clearance.

Title: Network Infrastructure Manager
Description:
**Summary**
The Network Infrastructure Manager leads Great HealthWorks' Network Operations and Telecommunications teams — System Administrators, Systems Engineers, Telecom Administrator, and Telecom Engineer/Architect — and carries direct technical accountability for the network, systems, and telecom environments the team supports. This includes firewalls and routing, server, storage, and virtualization infrastructure, as well as the Company's carrier, voice platform, and contact center stack.
  
  
This is a technical leadership position balanced with operational execution. The Infrastructure Manager serves as the primary owner of day-to-day operations and escalations, the main point of contact for business and IT stakeholders, and the driving force behind resolving complex technical issues. This role directly owns the operational layer while remaining hands-on enough to review designs, troubleshoot escalated issues, and lead through major incidents. Additionally, the role is responsible for instilling operational rigor—ensuring requirements discovery, runbooks, and post-change validation are seamlessly integrated into team workflows.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership & Team Management
  
  

* Directly manage and mentor the Network Operations team (System Administrators, Systems Engineers) and Telecommunications team (Telecom Administrator, Telecom Engineer/Architect); set technical priorities and hold the team to a high bar on quality
* Stay close enough to the environment to review designs and configurations, unblock hard technical problems, and lead the team through major incidents, including voice platform and contact center architecture decisions
* Hire and retain strong technical talent, conduct performance reviews, and manage staffing and on-call coverage for a 24/7 environment

Operational Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Serve as the primary day-to-day operational and escalation owner for Network Operations and Telecommunications — the first point of accountability when something breaks or a decision is needed
* Own communication with business and IT stakeholders on service health, incidents, and project status, serving as a transparent, trusted advisor to leadership.
* Translate technical issues into business impact, risk, and next steps for non-technical stakeholders and leadership
* Drive issue ownership and follow-through, ensuring every open issue has a clear owner, mitigation plan, and target resolution timeline.
* Coordinate across IT, vendors, and business teams to keep cross-functional work and vendor commitments moving
* Maintain visibility into service health, aging issues, recurring problems, and operational risk, and surface it proactively rather than waiting to be asked
* Define and apply clear criteria for what gets escalated to IT leadership versus what this role is expected to own and resolve independently

Network, Systems & Security Operations
  
  

* Own network security (firewall), routing and switching, EDR, and DNS filtering
* Own enterprise storage (Nimble, QNAP, Quantum), XCP-NG virtualization, Windows and Linux server administration (Linux-heavy), Active Directory, and Okta
* Own Microsoft 365 administration and build out the team's SharePoint administration capability
* Own AWS, Cloudflare, and integration of the broader SaaS footprint, plus server backup and disaster recovery
* Maintain PCI compliance across in-scope systems, ensure SLAs are met, and drive capacity planning and script/automation practices across the team

Telecommunications Operations
  
  

* Own operation of the Company's custom-built phone system, voice and data carrier services, and the contact center platform (e.g., NICE InContact/CXone), including the design and engineering work done by the Telecom Engineer/Architect
* Manage carrier relationships, SLAs, and invoicing; monitor the telecom service ticket queue (InvGate) and drive escalations to resolution
* Ensure telecom integrations (contact center, voice platform, speech IVR, SMS) stay supported and issues are triaged quickly

Planning, Documentation & Vendor Management
  
  

* Scope infrastructure and telecom projects up front — gather real requirements, build workable schedules, and keep initiatives on track
* Require runbooks for recurring operational and change work, and a validation step after major changes, so outcomes are confirmed and documented rather than assumed
* Manage vendor and carrier relationships and contracts, build business cases for technology investments, and own the network/systems/telecom budget

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
* 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, network, systems, or telecommunications
* 3+ years leading or mentoring technical staff
* Experience scoping and running technical projects — gathering requirements and managing timelines — without a dedicated PM function
* Experience as the primary operational and escalation owner for a technical team, including regular communication with non-technical business stakeholders
* Strong understanding of ITIL and formal change management

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Deep, current technical knowledge of networking (OSI, TCP/IP, routing/switching), firewalls, and identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta)
* Hands-on experience with Windows and Linux administration, enterprise storage (Nimble/QNAP/Quantum), and virtualization (XCP-NG or equivalent)
* Experience with AWS, Cloudflare, Microsoft 365, and integrating a broad SaaS footprint; SharePoint administration a plus
* Experience with carrier/telecom management, contact center platforms, and PCI compliance
* Scripting and automation fluency (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash, Ansible)
* Able to scope, document, and validate work without losing technical credibility with a highly technical team
* Strong ability to translate technical issues into business impact, risk, and next steps for non-technical audiences and leadership
* Proven stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination skills across IT, vendors, and business teams
* Excellent leadership and communication skills; highly self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working hands-on when needed

Physical Demands and Work Environment
  
  
While performing duties of job, incumbent is occasionally required to:
  
  

* May include local and out-of-town travel depending on business needs.
* Operate in a professional office environment.
* Constantly use work-related equipment.
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
* Sit for extended periods of time (up to 10 hours per day).
* Lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand, as necessary.
* Ability to work regular, full-time schedule, Monday through Friday with the flexibility to work additional hours depending on business demands.

Title: IT Director (Digital Operations)
Description:

Sonance Financial launched in October 2026, bringing together founder-led advisory firms in Lethbridge, Ottawa, Edmonton and Phoenix. We are building one operating model and one modern technology platform, and we need an experienced technology leader to make it work across every office.

**About the role**

As our first in-house technology leader, the IT Director (Digital Operations) is a hands-on role. You will be the bridge between our people and our managed IT services partner: you'll turn business needs into clear requirements, solve problems directly, and hold vendors to a high standard. You will also lead our first practical steps with AI and own our IT and AI policies. This is a chance to build technology at a growing wealth firm from the ground up, with a clear path to Head of Technology as we grow.

Reporting to the CEO on an interim basis. You will work closely with the Director of Integrations, the Director of Support Services and the Chief Compliance Officer. The role has no direct reports at launch.

**What you'll do**

* **IT operations and managed services:**
  Own the relationship with our managed IT services partner, including escalations, invoices and monthly service reviews. Troubleshoot hands-on across devices, networks, Teams calling and meeting rooms.
* **Identity, SSO and client portal:**
  Roll out Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on with MFA for all users. Support the launch of our client portal and resolve login issues. Run joiner, mover and leaver processes and quarterly access reviews.
* **Partner firm onboarding:**
  Build a repeatable playbook so every new office is fully working on day one. This covers device setup, Microsoft 365 email and file migration, platform access, and retiring legacy systems.
* **Platform vendors:**
  Oversee our wealth-management platforms (CRM, portfolio accounting, financial planning, ERP and related tools), keep vendor oversight records, and evaluate new tools.
* **AI enablement:**
  Work with an outside consultant to pilot practical AI workflows and scale the ones that work. Make sure each one is signed off by Compliance, and keep an inventory of AI tools.
* **Security, continuity and policy:**
  Run our information security program with our IT partner, including the annual risk assessment, vulnerability testing, incident response and staff training. Test our business continuity and disaster recovery plans every year, maintain the IT and AI policy framework, and provide evidence for audits and due diligence.
* **Strategy and budget:**
  Keep a rolling technology roadmap, manage the technology budget, and report progress to leadership.

**What success looks like in your first year**

* The client portal is live with single sign-on.
* A clear support model is in place with our IT partner, with SLA reporting every month.
* Our IT and AI policy framework is approved and covered in staff training.
* We have a full inventory of systems, vendors and licences, plus a 2–3 year technology roadmap.
* Two or three AI pilots have been delivered, with measured results.

**What you bring**

* 5+ years in IT or technology management, including oversight of managed service providers and vendors.
* Hands-on Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Entra ID, Intune) and experience implementing SSO.
* A track record of delivering migrations from start to finish.
* Working knowledge of security frameworks (NIST or CIS), incident response and business continuity planning.
* Knowledge of Canadian privacy and record-keeping requirements for financial services, such as PIPEDA and securities regulator expectations.
* A genuinely AI-forward mindset, balanced with good judgment about risk.
* A calm, clear communicator who can support people across several offices and time zones.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in wealth management or other regulated financial services.
* Familiarity with wealth platforms such as CRM, portfolio accounting, custodian integrations and client portals.
* A degree in Computer Science or Management Information Systems, or equivalent experience.

**The details**

* Full-time, permanent. This posting is for an existing vacancy.
* Hybrid, based in Ontario (Greater Toronto Area preferred), with up to about 20% travel to our offices.
* Base salary range: $130,000 – $180,000 CAD per year, depending on experience.
* Sonance Financial does not use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this position.

**Description**
The Escalation Manager sits at the heart of Infor's Escalation Management (EM) team — a global team dedicated to reducing customer distress, boosting satisfaction, and protecting the SaaS revenue that drives our business forward.
  
  
When critical customer situations occur, the Escalation Manager jumps into action: owning end-to-end resolution with decisive leadership, orchestrating cross-functional teams, and maintaining relentless focus until the customer is back on track. The commander in the room, this strategic hands-on role is trusted by stakeholders to cut through complexity, mobilize the right people at every level, and drive outcomes with urgency and clarity.
  
  
Beyond crisis response, Escalation Managers collaborate across a global network of peers to deliver 24/7 coverage, drive proactive risk management and continuous improvement with key insights, and uphold the quality standards that make Infor's escalation practice world-class. This is a role for decisive leaders who thrive under pressure, lead with empathy and clarity at every level, and are genuinely energized by delivering for customers in high-stakes moments.
  
  
**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**

* Escalation leadership & resolution: Take decisive command of critical escalations end-to-end — qualifying incoming escalations, setting direction, leading the resolution team and serve as the final decision-maker (in alignment with key stakeholders), removing blockers and driving to closure with urgency and clear accountability.
* Resolution planning & execution: Build and manage structured resolution plans with defined owners, deadlines, and prioritized actions — running the equivalent of a war room when the situation demands and conducting root cause analysis to prevent recurrence.
* Stakeholder communication: Own all communication throughout the escalation lifecycle — synthesizing complexity into clear, timely updates for executive stakeholders, customers, and internal teams alike, and preparing executive summaries for senior leadership.
* Resource mobilization: Rapidly identify and deploy the right Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and leaders across Product, Development, Sales, and Services — navigating a global matrix with influence and speed to secure the resources needed.
* Proactive risk management: Monitor customer health metrics and early-warning signals to identify at-risk accounts and intervene before situations become critical, especially ahead of renewal cycles.
* Quality & global operations: Uphold escalation reporting standards, contribute to global EM coverage across time zones, and conduct root-cause analysis and lessons-learned to surface insights that drive systemic improvement across the organization.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in a customer-facing service, support, technical account management or escalation management role within enterprise SaaS / software, with a solid understanding of enterprise software delivery, support operations and customer lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams through high-pressure, time-critical resolution scenarios with measurable outcomes.

Title: Senior Service Delivery Manager – Transportation Technology (ITS)
Head of Service Delivery
Description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.
  
  
We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.
  
  
We're looking for a
**Head of Service Delivery**
at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.
  
  
Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.
  
  
**What You Might Bring To The Table**
You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:
  
  

* Direct people-management experience leading managers or team leads, not just individual contributors.
* You are service-obsessed and focused on how we deliver outstanding service to patients, partners, and colleagues alike.
* A track record managing vendors within a healthcare operations role.
* Experience managing third-party vendor relationships, including contract negotiation and SLA governance.
* Experience overseeing Workforce Management (WFM) — forecasting, scheduling, and intraday management.
* Experience building or overseeing Quality Assurance (QA) programs, including audit frameworks and calibration.
* A data-first mindset, comfortable building and reading vendor and team scorecards.
* Comfort operating at high speed without compromising on execution quality.
* Strong communication skills, able to translate complex, cross-functional work for executives and your own team alike.
* Experience redesigning operational workflows around automation or AI, with results you can quantify: handle time, cost per order, headcount avoided.
* Able to build a capacity model that forecasts both human and automated throughput, and shows where the next headcount dollar should go versus the next automation dollar.
* Experience structuring vendor contracts for shifts in workload: volume flexibility, per-outcome pricing, exit terms, and automation clauses.
* Comfortable setting quality standards for automated and agentic systems, and holding Product and Engineering to them.
* A working view on PHI and AI: what data can enter which tools, what a BAA must cover, and how to audit it.
* Able to judge AI vendor claims. You can tell a demo from a deployed result and ask for the evidence.

**What You Will Achieve In This Role**
This role sits within Service Delivery, reporting directly to the SVP of Operations. You'll own two core pillars — Workforce Management (WFM) and Quality Assurance (QA) — plus our vendor partnerships, leading a small team of functional leads (a WFM Lead and a QA Lead) who run the day-to-day.
  
  
**Role**
As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:
  
  

* Build, lead, and develop a team of functional leads across WFM and QA, growing their capability to run their pillars independently.
* Own the end-to-end vendor lifecycle — sourcing, onboarding, contract structuring, performance management, and offboarding.
* Set the strategy for Quality Assurance (QA) — audit frameworks, calibration, scorecards, and coaching feedback loops. You will also be standing up the infrastructure for product testing on behalf of operational functions.
* Set the strategy for Workforce Management (WFM) — demand forecasting, staffing plans, scheduling, and capacity modeling — across internal and outsourced teams.
* Standardize reporting across QA and WFM, including SLA/KPI dashboards and vendor and team scorecards.
* Partner with the SVP of Operations on Service Delivery strategy, headcount planning, and budget for the function.
* Represent Service Delivery in cross-functional and executive conversations, translating team-level performance into business impact.
* Lead HIPAA compliance and data security oversight across all outsourced operations. - Own the automation roadmap for Service Delivery.
* Set and own a target for cost per order, defect rates, and key cost metrics
* Rebuild WFM to forecast mixed human and automated capacity, so staffing plans and vendor commitments track the real demand curve, in real time.
* Help set the quality framework for agentic workflows: error tolerance, escalation paths, human-in-the-loop points, and audit coverage.
* Act as the operational owner for Product and Engineering on Courier automation. Define what good looks like, test it, and sign off before patient-facing release.
* Make AI-assisted work the default across your team, and measure adoption and output gains at team level.
* Lead HIPAA and data security oversight across outsourced operations and AI tooling, including vendor due diligence and BAAs.

**Ai Requirements**
At Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done as a result.
  
  
**Tier 1 — AI-Native**
For this role, the expectation is that you are AI-native. You build with AI directly, shipping, automating, or prototyping real work with LLMs and agents, and have clear judgment on where humans must stay in the loop.
  
  

* You build with AI, not just alongside it. You've shipped, automated, or prototyped something real using LLMs, agents, or AI tooling.
* You can explain a workflow you redesigned so a machine does the boring 80%.
* You have a view on where agentic systems help and where a human must stay in the loop, especially in regulated, PHI-adjacent work.

**A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE**
We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.
  
  
**How We Will Interview You**
We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:
  
  

* 30-minute introductory phone call with our Senior Talent Partner.
* If it feels like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.
* 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to this role (see AI Requirements above).
* Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call.
* Offer!

**What We Offer**
We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:
  
  

* Salary range of $150,000 - $180,000
* Equity package
* Flexible remote or hybrid work options
* Dedicated personal development budget
* Medical, vision, and dental coverage
* 28+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best
* Paid parental leave
* 401k retirement plan
* All the equipment you need to do your best work
* Inclusive, people-first policies designed by our team, for our team

**DIVERSITY AT**
**SCAN.COM**
Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.
  
  
We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.
  
  
Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.
  
  
If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com.
  
  
We look forward to receiving your application!

Title: Sr Manager, IT Service Delivery
Description:
Anteris® Technologies is a global structural heart company dedicated to revolutionizing cardiac care. With offices in Minneapolis, MN, US; Geneva, Switzerland; and Brisbane and Perth, Australia, we have a growing and inclusive team.
  
  
Our mission is to forge new frontiers in cardiac care by pioneering science-driven and measurable advancements to restore heart valve patients to healthy function. Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) technologies were originally designed for older, high-risk patients. Today, younger, more active patients need a better solution that will not just open and close but restore healthy heart function. We seek to restore healthy blood flow patterns by creating the world’s first biomimetic TAVR valve, DurAVR® THV. This cutting-edge valve, incorporating our proprietary ADAPT® anti-calcification technology, is designed to mimic the natural function of a healthy heart valve.
  
  
*Build the service model. Lead the team. Shape how our employees experience IT.*
We are a young, growing company, and our IT organization is growing with it. That makes this a build-and-lead role, not a caretaker role. The person who joins us will have the opportunity to define and own how IT service delivery works across the organization: how employees get help, how support is staffed and measured, how issues are escalated, how vendors fit into the model, and what a great technology experience should look like as we scale.
  
  
The audience is broad. You and your team will support field personnel, commercial and sales teams as those capabilities grow, R&D engineers, Quality and regulatory functions, corporate teams, executives, and everyone in between. This role will be one of the most visible faces of IT to our internal customers. How this function performs will shape how the organization experiences and judges IT - good or bad.
  
  
We are looking for a leader who values real IT discipline and great customer experience, in equal measure. Great CX does not mean saying yes to everything. It means being responsive, reliable, consistent, easy to work with, transparent about priorities, and willing to say “no” or “not that way” when a one-off request conflicts with security, standards, scalability, or our shared business goals. It also means representing the internal customer inside IT and holding our own teams and partners accountable when the experience, responsiveness, or quality of service falls short of the standard we are trying to build.
  
  
As Anteris grows, this role will grow with it. The service model, team structure, global coverage, technology estate, and business expectations will all become more complex. For the right leader, that creates meaningful opportunity to expand scope, responsibility, and career progression as the company and IT organization mature.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Lead and develop our Service Desk, deskside support, and related Service Delivery resources (employees, contractors, and service partners) with clear expectations, coaching, accountability, and career development.
* Define and mature a scalable global IT service-delivery model across support channels, locations, vendors, escalation paths, service levels, and operating hours.
* Own the employee technology experience within Service Delivery and use service data, customer feedback, ticket trends, and direct engagement to identify friction and drive measurable improvement.
* Establish practical ITSM discipline across incident, request, problem, knowledge, change, service catalog, asset, and continual-improvement practices. We want rigor that improves outcomes, not process for process’s sake.
* Lead significant incidents and escalations with calm, clear ownership — coordinating technical teams, vendors, business stakeholders, communications, and follow-through through resolution and post-incident improvement.
* Lead Service Delivery projects and improvement initiatives such as ITSM enhancements, service-model changes, endpoint or technology deployments, office/site support changes, vendor transitions, automation, and self-service improvements.
* Own service-provider performance and ensure MSPs and vendors operate as an extension of our team, with clear accountability for quality, responsiveness, customer experience, and contractual commitments.
* Lead end-user technology fulfillment and lifecycle practices, including onboarding/offboarding, device provisioning, asset control, refresh planning, recovery, and retirement.
* Partner closely with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Applications, Data, Quality, HR, Facilities, and business leadership so employees experience one IT organization rather than disconnected technical teams.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Employees know where to go for help, receive consistent service, and trust that IT will own issues through resolution.
* The Service Delivery team is well-led, accountable, developing professionally, and increasingly able to solve problems without unnecessary escalation.
* Service levels, backlog, recurring issues, customer experience, vendor performance, and improvement priorities are visible and actively managed, not anecdotally.
* IT becomes more disciplined as we grow: better standardization, better knowledge, more automation, fewer repeat problems, and clearer ownership.
* You are a credible partner to the business: customer-focused and pragmatic, while protecting enterprise standards, security, compliance, scalability, and shared priorities.
* You are a credible leader inside of IT - where we look to you for voice-of-the-customer and help IT deliver IT correctly.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will also be considered.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, IT operations, end-user computing, IT service management, or related technology disciplines.
* 5+ years of people-management experience with direct leadership of Service Desk, deskside/end-user support, IT operations, or comparable technology teams.

* Experience leading technology or service-improvement projects from planning through implementation and transition to support; formal project-management certification is useful but not required.

* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft-centric workplace technology, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, SaaS applications, endpoint management, identity/access concepts, and enterprise service-management tools.
* Experience supporting multiple sites or a distributed/global workforce.
* Experience in medical device, life sciences, manufacturing, healthcare, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.
* A leadership style that combines service orientation, sound judgment, technical credibility, operational discipline, and the confidence to challenge weak assumptions or unsustainable requests.

Title: Lead Major Incident Manager
Description:
**Business Introduction**
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Digital & Tech Command Centre operates 24x7x365 to protect GSK’s critical sites, applications and services. Disruption or degradation to these directly impacts patient supply, research and colleague productivity.
  
  
This role owns and leads the end-to-end response to Major Incidents (P1) and managed high-priority (P2) incidents. In collaboration with AI-enabled monitoring, detection and triage capabilities, the role directs resolver
  
  
teams and subject matter experts from across Tech towards the fastest possible restoration of service, while providing accurate, timely and audience-appropriate communication to end users, senior stakeholders and
  
  
executive leadership. The role also assesses incidents for crisis potential, secures the quality of the incident record for downstream Problem Management, and drives continuous improvement in prevention, detection and response - including the adoption of AI and automation to shorten time to detect, time to engage and time to restore. As a more experienced member of the Major Incident Manager team, the role additionally acts as an escalation point within the team, to support less experienced colleagues, as well as to field senior stakeholders’ questions and requests for information. Additionally, the role supports management of the shift rota, supports the personal
  
  
development of Major Incident Managers through structured feedback and mentoring and leads service-related objectives such as Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  
**Major Incident Response & Command**

* Own the end-to-end management of Major Incidents (P1) and managed high-priority (P2) incidents, from detection through to confirmed service restoration, acting as the single point of control for the duration of the incident.
* Rapidly establish impact, urgency and scope, confirm correct prioritisation, and drive immediate engagement of the right resolver teams, subject matter experts and vendors.
* Lead technical bridges with authority, keeping activity focused on restoration, controlling scope, and ensuring hypotheses are tested and eliminated systematically.
* Drive and record decisions under pressure – balancing speed of restoration against risk.
* Drive resolution against agreed major incident targets, escalating promptly where progress stalls or
* additional authority, resource or vendor commitment is required.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Own incident communications, producing accurate, timely and audience-appropriate updates, including for senior leaders, at agreed intervals.
* Translate complex technical detail into clear business impact language, setting realistic expectations on restoration.
* Act as an escalation point for senior stakeholders’ questions and requests for information, coordinating accurate, consistent responses across resolver teams and owning follow-up through to closure.

**Incident Assessment, Categorisation & Escalation**

* Continuously assess live incidents for impact, applying criteria to determine appropriate handling.
* Trigger escalation routes without delay, providing the initial situational assessment.
* Maintain awareness of site criticality, business-critical periods and service dependencies so that escalation decisions reflect true business risk.

**Service Quality, Data & Continuous Improvement**

* Secure the quality, completeness and accuracy of the incident record – timeline, impact, actions taken and causal indicators – so that Problem Management can be effective.
* Lead or contribute to post-incident reviews, ensuring findings, follow-up actions and preventative measures are captured, owned and tracked to closure.
* Identify recurring themes, fragile services and gaps in monitoring, alerting, knowledge or runbooks, and feed these into improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to the development and adoption of AI, automation and data-driven tooling that shorten time to detect, time to engage and time to restore.
* Drive continual improvements into process and playbooks.
* Lead defined service-related objectives, such as Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives, owning them end to end and tracking measurable improvement.

**Shift Operations & Readiness**

* Operate as part of a 24x7x365 shift pattern, including public holiday and on-call working as required.
* Support management of the shift rota, helping to ensure balanced, compliant 24x7x365 cover across regions, and flagging gaps, fatigue and coverage risks to the Senior Major Incident Manager.
* Deliver rigorous shift handovers so that live incidents, risks and pending actions transfer seamlessly with no loss of context or momentum.
* Maintain personal and team readiness through participation in recovery tests, crisis simulations and major incident rehearsals.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Acts as an escalation point within the team, providing support to less experienced colleagues.
* Support the personal development of Major Incident Managers, including through structured feedback sessions and mentoring, helping to raise the capability, consistency and resilience of the MIM
* community.
* Approach and Collaboration
* Bring a team-first collaborative mindset and approach, to ensure effective cross-functional working.

Why You?
  
  
**Basic Qualification**
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Computer Science, IT or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years in IT service operations within a large, complex, global organisation, including time in a Major Incident Management role.
* ITIL v4 certification is required.
* Experience with leading P1 incidents end to end, directing multiple technical teams and third parties concurrently.

Title: Senior Technical Incident Manager

**New York, NY | Financial Services / Quantitative Trading**

A leading quantitative investment firm is seeking a
**Senior Technical Incident Manager**
to lead the response and recovery of business-critical technology incidents across a highly automated trading environment. This role sits at the intersection of technology, operations, and business leadership, ensuring stability and resilience across platforms that support trading, research, execution, and risk functions.

* Lead major technology incidents from initial triage through restoration and recovery validation.
* Coordinate engineering, infrastructure, application support, and third-party teams during high-severity incidents.

* Maintain detailed incident documentation, timelines, and decision logs within ITSM platforms.
* Facilitate post-incident reviews, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, controls, tooling, automation, and overall service resilience.
* Partner with Technology, Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to support regulatory requirements, audit readiness, business continuity, and operational resilience initiatives.

* 10+ years of experience in technology operations, production support, service management, or infrastructure operations within financial services, trading, or capital markets environments.
* Strong hands-on background in Production Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Application Support, or Infrastructure Operations.
* Proven experience leading major incident response and driving controlled recovery during critical outages.
* Strong understanding of trading platforms, service dependencies, change management processes, and operational risk.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis and implementing process improvements.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders under pressure.
* Experience supporting regulated environments and working with organizations such as the SEC and FINRA is highly desirable.

* Experience with Python, Shell scripting, or workflow automation.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or comparable ITSM tools.

* Exposure to observability and monitoring platforms.

Why Join?
  
  

You'll play a critical role in protecting the stability of a sophisticated trading environment, working alongside engineering, trading, and operations teams to ensure business continuity and operational resilience at one of the most technically advanced firms in the industry.
